title: ProtAIDe-Dx deep learning diagnoses six dementia-related conditions from plasma proteomics
summary: ProtAIDe-Dx is a deep joint-learning model on 17,187 patients and controls that uses plasma proteomics to give simultaneous probabilistic diagnoses across six conditions associated with dementia. Cross-validated balanced accuracy was 70-95% with AUC above 78%, and the diagnoses were associated with pathology-specific biomarkers in an external memory clinic sample.
ai_technology: ProtAIDe-Dx deep joint-learning model on plasma proteomics

evidence.tested: Cross-validation in 17,187 participants plus an external memory clinic sample.
evidence.unknown: Main performance is cross-validated; no prospective clinical use shown; abstract only; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Deep learning combined plasma proteins into probabilistic diagnoses and highlighted discriminating proteins.
